description: This PHP script facilitates exporting test cases in XML format from the TestLink test management system. It handles user requests, generates XML content representing test plan contexts and test cases, and enables file downloads of the exported data.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan data retrieval from the database.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project data retrieval.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class representing platform data within a test project.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class, used for Smarty templates.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test case data and export functions.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and collects request parameters into an arguments object.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI context object based on test plan info and parameters.

methods.name: contentAsXML
methods.description: Generates an XML representation of the test execution set including context and test cases.

methods.name: contextAsXML
methods.description: Creates XML describing the context such as project, plan, build, and platform.

methods.name: tcaseSetAsXML
methods.description: Exports a set of test cases to XML based on provided test case versions.
